thread:
jamie: T-40 to EU change window. Quick preflight: who's running the smoke, who owns unpin/rollback, and any migration notes? @nora @tariq

nora: I'll run smoke for search + embeddings. No DB schema changes in this release. smoke script: `/ci/smoke_eu.sh --suite=search,embeds --id=eu-1716600000`

tariq: Proposing to pin service -> release-2024-11 (build b12). Rollout plan: canary 3% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% with 5m holds. Rollback triggers: error_rate >= 2.5% (5m) OR user-facing 5xx > 1% OR p95 latency spike > 600ms. Liz is on-call exec? @ops-oncall

ops-oncall: oncall is @sam. He confirmed and will escalate as needed. Dash links in channel in 1m.

deploy-bot: Starting canary: canary_id=canary-1716600000 target=3% version=release-2024-11

jamie: Note — release notes are up: https://docs.internal/releases/release-2024-11. Highlight: reduced memory footprint for kv-cache and improved batching heuristics. Please avoid hotfix pushes to this branch during the window.

nora: smoke run started. Quick sanity: searches return expected top hits, embed vectors stable (cosine drift < 0.002).

deploy-bot: Canary update: canary-1716600000 metrics={error_rate:0.1%, p95_ms:190, qps:32} status=OK

tariq: moving to 20% now. Config updated: `rollout.percent=20` and `pinned=release-2024-11`

nora: smoke complete: search/e2e  PASS, embeddings drift within tolerance. Load ramp small p95 improvement vs baseline. Attaching logs. :white_check_mark:

ops-oncall: dashboards: https://grafana.internal/d/rollouts/eu-release-2024-11 ; alerts set for the thresholds. Pager on sam.

jamie: Hold at 20 for 10m. If stable, proceed to 60 -> 100. Remember: quiet window in effect, no merges to main-release branch.

tariq: ack. I'll post a brief post-deploy checklist after 100%: smoke summary, a couple trace samples, and CPU/GPU utilization snapshot.

nora: all green so far. Starting the 10m timer. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: Rolling to 60% now (canary-1716600000)

ops-oncall: small blip on endpoint-a around t+12m (error_rate 0.8%) — auto-alert but within rollback thresholds. Watching.

jamie: thanks — keep an eye. If it hits >2.5% for 5m, call rollback.

ops-oncall: blip resolved, trace indicates transient DB timeout; no rollback. Marking incident as mitigated.

tariq: proceeding to 100% rollout. Pin remains release-2024-11.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: 100% target achieved for release-2024-11. final_metrics={error_rate:0.12%, p95_ms:220}

nora: posting final smoke artifacts and summary in thread. All checks green.

jamie: great job. Keeping silence for 30m post-rollout. After that we can open the branch for minor non-critical merges. Please add a short note to #release-notes channel with bullet points.

tariq: will drop checklist + quick retrospective if anything pops up. Thanks team. :rocket:
